concerns.text: FR-006 (paired t‑test of proxy vs. full‑hardware‑sync baseline) is not fully satisfied: T009 runs a paired‑t test on acceptance rates and reasoning scores, but the spec requires a comparison of policy acceptance rates *and* final scores against a *full‑hardware‑sync* baseline. No task generates the full‑hardware‑sync baseline data, so the required ground‑truth comparison is missing.

SC-005 (end‑to‑end runtime ≤ 6 hours, n ≥ 300 samples) has no verification step. None of the listed tasks record or assert the total pipeline runtime or enforce the 6‑hour limit, leaving this success criterion untestable.

The implementation plan references task T029 ‘Implement Full Hardware Sync Baseline’, but tasks.md does not contain a T029 entry. This creates a mismatch between plan and task list and leaves FR‑006 without a concrete implementation, violating the specification.
